gate.rule: |final_translation_mm(mock) - final_translation_mm(mujoco)| <= 3 and |final_rotation_deg(mock) - final_rotation_deg(mujoco)| <= 0.3 at the cap, every start; ART-VS's artvs_switched True on every start in both worlds

rule.artvs_switch: artvs_switched True on every start in both worlds
rule.landing: every arm, every start: |d final_translation_mm| <= 3 and |d final_rotation_deg| <= 0.3 at the cap, mock vs mujoco

rule.artvs_switch: the two worlds agree on whether it fires on each start and, where both fire, on when (|d switch step| <= 5)
rule.landing: sift_ransac and artvs: unchanged; vitvs_dinov3 / vitvs_dinov2: the landing is reported, gated by the curve rule instead
rule.vitvs_curve: per start: |d median t_mm over steps 101-150| <= 3 and |d median r_deg over steps 101-150| <= 0.5, mock vs mujoco; AND the spread (median over the starts of those two differences) no larger than the same spread between mujoco960 and mujoco (the half-pixel control)
